groups.name: data_platform
groups.responsibility: Typed staging and reusable intermediate logic; no consumer reads these directly.

groups.name: partner_analytics
groups.responsibility: Curated facts, dimensions and marts that dashboards and partner teams consume.

groups.name: platform_ops
groups.responsibility: Warehouse budgets, credit attribution and the cost of every dbt model.

models.name: int_partner_review_features
models.description: One row per submission with partner review history available at submission time. The current review duration remains the observed label.

models.name: int_partner_tier_asof_submission
models.description: Partner tier valid at submission time; events before the first snapshot capture remain unknown.

models.name: int_submission_lifecycle
models.description: Review attempts ordered within each title. One row per submission.

models.name: int_title_outcomes
models.description: One row per title; submission and publication streams are aggregated separately before joining to prevent fanout.

models.name: int_title_publication_features
models.description: One row per approved title. Partner history is calculated separately at first submission and at approval, using only titles published strictly before each point. Current publication remains an observed outcome.

models.name: dim_partner
models.description: One row per partner; a synthetic current-state dimension.

models.name: dim_title
models.description: One row per game or content title.

models.name: fct_submission
models.description: One row per publishing review attempt.

columns.name: return_reason
columns.description: Why a rejected attempt was returned; shared with the submitting partner only.

models.name: mart_partner_health
models.description: One row per partner. An illustrative health score in [0, 1] from three equally weighted components (Wilson lower bound on first-pass approval, recency, shelf conversion). Weights are a discussion starting point, not a validated model; low-sample partners are flagged and should not be ranked.

columns.name: is_low_sample
columns.description: True when the partner has fewer submitted titles than var('health_min_titles').

models.name: mart_partner_publishing
models.description: Partner-level publishing health. All title outcomes are combined at title grain before this aggregation.

columns.name: first_pass_approval_pct
columns.description: Approved on attempt one divided by titles with at least one submission, multiplied by 100.

columns.name: avg_review_hours
columns.description: Total review hours divided by reviewed attempts.

columns.name: avg_publication_lead_days
columns.description: Average days from first submission to first publication among published titles.

models.name: mart_partner_statistical_diagnostics
models.description: Descriptive partner and overall summaries; Wilson calculations are teaching examples, not intervals inferred from a random sample.

models.name: mart_resubmission_cost
models.description: One row per return reason. Rejected attempts, reviewer hours spent on them, and the days each rejection added before the partner resubmitted.

columns.name: avg_days_added
columns.description: Mean days from the rejected submission to the next submission of the same title.

models.name: mart_title_time_to_shelf
models.description: One row per title at a fixed clock, var('opportunity_as_of_date'). Shows whether an approved title has reached a storefront, how long it has waited and how much slack remains before its planned release. Events after the clock are treated as unobserved.

columns.name: days_waiting_as_of
columns.description: Days from approval to the clock for approved titles with no storefront event yet.

models.name: mart_workflow_did_demo
models.description: Difference-in-differences arithmetic over a separate, entirely invented two-cohort weekly fixture.

models.name: cost_warehouse_daily
models.description: Daily credits and cost per warehouse up to var('cost_as_of_date'). Compute and cloud-services credits are kept apart, as Snowflake bills them.

models.name: mart_cost_budget_vs_actual
models.description: One row per warehouse. Month-to-date credits against the resource-monitor quota, a straight-line forecast to month end, and a status that follows the monitor's notify and suspend triggers.

models.name: mart_cost_by_model
models.description: Month-to-date dbt warehouse credits allocated to each model by its share of that day's execution time. The allocation reconciles to the metered NEXUS_DBT_WH total.

models.name: mart_cost_by_user
models.description: Month-to-date credits attributed to each service user and role. Attribution excludes idle time, so it is always below metered compute.

models.name: mart_cost_daily
models.description: One row per warehouse per day with cumulative month-to-date credits and a trailing seven-day baseline. Days above var('cost_anomaly_ratio') times the baseline are flagged.

exposures.name: platform_cost_and_lineage
exposures.label: Platform cost and lineage (synthetic portfolio example)
